messages:
ava: Heads-up: kicking off a controlled kernel+driver+fw validation run in the canary pool now. Goal: reduce XID/ECC spikes and validate that drain->evict->replace works under load. Plan is staged rollouts with telemetry gating and automatic rollback. tagging: canary-xid-1912. @miguel @sarah please ack and add any extra workload profiles.

miguel: ack. I'll add a continuous compute shader loop and a multi-workload mix (inference + dataloader IO) to mimic host saturation. Will push a job template to infra-jobs.

sarah: ack. Please make sure we include a long-seq (4k) attention run to exercise KV cache eviction patterns. last time short seqs didn't catch the cache blowouts.

dave: noted. Also adding a drain-time monitor — we saw a few nodes hitting 12-15m due to pod preemption in the last rollout. Suggest force-evict at 10m + log snapshot.

lin: FYI telemetry: two cards in us-west-2 had repeated ECC bursts after the last driver bump (tagged in metrics as gpu-uw2-34 and gpu-uw2-47). We'll pre-pin them to exclude from canary, then drain and repro in isolation.

ops-bot: deploy plan created: canary-xid-1912. Rolling size: 5 nodes, soak: 30m, telemetry gates: xids_per_hour < 0.7x baseline, ECC_errors == 0. To trigger: `/run-canary canary-xid-1912 --run-id=1912349999`

miguel: question — what kernel/userspace combo are we validating? list it in the run.

ava: kernels: 6.1.35 -> 6.1.38, drivers: 535.86 -> 536.21, fw: 54.02 -> 54.05. We'll validate both incremental and the full-upgrade path.

dave: added a smoke harness that runs `stress-ng --gpu 4 --timeout 3600s` + a small inference loop. Output logs to /var/log/canary/1912349999/. Example grep to extract XIDs:```sudo journalctl -k | grep -E "Xid|NVRM: Xid"```

lin: when you collect logs, include `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,PERF,DRV` and NVML counters every 30s. I'll correlate with telemetry.

ops-bot: gate update: first rolling batch passed telemetry at 30m. Moving to next batch.

miguel: provisioning note — some older SKUs in eu-west still have mixed DIMMs causing higher ECC baseline. We should exclude eu-west-1-b in this run or adjust baseline thresholds.

ava: agreed. Excluding eu-west-1-b. Also enabling extra sampling (trace) for any node that reports XID > 1 in a batch.

lin: after batch 3 we saw a subtle syscall trace: `gpu_reset_client: pid=4321` correlated with an oom_kill on a sidecar. Could be scheduling interaction, not pure driver bug. Adding variable load tests to catch that.

miguel: FYI I pushed a temp kernel module patch that logs extra NVML state on fault — we'll only load it on isolated repro nodes.

ops-bot: run complete: final summary -> 28 nodes validated, 1 node flagged for isolated repro (gpu-uw2-47), XID rate 0.6x baseline, ECC events unchanged. Action items: isolate gpu-uw2-47, schedule firmware reflash, and run extended 24h repro in isolated pool.

ava: solid. Thanks team. Next steps: create follow-up ticket with links to logs and telemetry dashboards, schedule firmware reflash window for flagged nodes next Tue 02:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

sarah: I'll own the repro ticket and run the extended workload. ping me on slack if you need logs.

miguel: leaving a short checklist in the ticket: `snapshot config`, `snapshot nv-host` logs, `drain node`, `reflash fw`, `rejoin pool`, `verify XID/ECC metrics 24h`.

ava: thanks — closing this thread when ticket is up.
